subtitles.zh: 今年日元汇率跌至四十年来最低水平。
subtitles.en: The yen has been at levels not seen in four decades this year.

subtitles.zh: 上次日元对美元如此疲软还要追溯到1986年。
subtitles.en: In 1986, the last time that we were this week, for the yen against the US dollar.

subtitles.zh: 2026年7月，1美元可兑换164日元。
subtitles.en: In July 2026, it took 164 yen to buy a single US dollar.

subtitles.zh: 五年前这一数字为102。日元问题不仅困扰着担忧生活成本的日本决策者，也令美国头疼。
subtitles.en: Five years ago, it was 102. The yen is a problem not only for Japanese policy makers who are worried about the cost of living, but also for America.

subtitles.zh: 这是因为日本持有的美国债务规模超过除美国自身外的任何国家。
subtitles.en: That's because Japan owns the most US debt of any country except America itself.

subtitles.zh: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特对此并不避讳介入。
subtitles.en: And US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has not been shy about getting involved.

subtitles.zh: 我拥有不对称信息。现在我是庄家。
subtitles.en: I have asymmetric information. I am the house now.

subtitles.zh: 斯科特·贝森特的做法绝对是史无前例的。
subtitles.en: What is absolutely unprecedented is the way that Scott Bessent has gone about doing it.

subtitles.zh: 他实质上是在说，别跟我对着干。
subtitles.en: He's essentially saying, don't butt against me.

subtitles.zh: 那么，美国为何试图控制日元？
subtitles.en: So why is the US trying to control the yen?

subtitles.zh: 日元走弱，因为日本央行一直维持低利率。
subtitles.en: The yen is weak because the bank of Japan has kept interest rates low.

subtitles.zh: 这对一些人是好消息。东京现在到处都是游客，对他们来说购物很划算。
subtitles.en: That's good news for some. In Tokyo, there's tourists everywhere right now and for them, shopping is a bargain.

subtitles.zh: 像丰田和日产这样的公司，由于日元疲软，利润强劲。
subtitles.en: Companies like Toyota and Nissan, they're seeing strong profits due to the weekend.

subtitles.zh: 但对其他人来说是坏消息。日本是一个几乎全部能源都依赖进口的岛国。
subtitles.en: But bad news for others. Japan is an island that imports especially all of its energy.

subtitles.zh: 对日本首相高市早苗来说，这带来了政治问题。
subtitles.en: For Japan's Prime Minister, Sanae Takaiichi, this creates political problems.

subtitles.zh: 当民众生活成本上升时，她的支持率就会下降。
subtitles.en: When people's cost of living goes up, her popularity goes down.
